name: Ulta Beauty Rewards Mastercard

apr.notes: Variable APRs as of the January 2026 print date of the filed agreement; balance transfers use the purchase APR. Balance transfer and cash advance fees are $10 or 5%, whichever is greater. Late fee up to $41.

base_rate.description: 1 point for every $3 spent outside of Ulta Beauty.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points you can redeem for savings through Ulta Beauty Rewards.

signup_bonus.description: Enjoy 500 Welcome Bonus Points when you spend $500 in the first 90 days outside of Ulta Beauty.

benefits.title: 20% off your first purchase
benefits.description: 20% off your first qualifying purchase at Ulta Beauty when you open and use your card.

benefits.title: Beyond Ulta Beauty Rewards
benefits.description: Earn cashback from exclusive deals through Beyond Ulta Beauty Rewards.

notes: Issued by Comenity Capital Bank (Bread Financial). The filed agreement covers both the Ulta Beauty Rewards Mastercard and the Ulta Beauty Rewards World Mastercard; which one is issued is not stated publicly, so network_tier is none. Applicants not eligible for the Mastercard may be considered for the store card.
